description.value: Gas Plus — marketed by GP Fuels as 'Fairmont Gas Plus' — is a fuel station and convenience store on Fairmont Frontage Road in the Columbia Valley resort community of Fairmont Hot Springs. Part of the regional GP Fuels network operating in the East Kootenay region of BC, it is one of the few roadside service stops in a stretch of valley dominated by the Fairmont Hot Springs resort. For touring cyclists riding the Columbia Valley corridor between Radium Hot Springs and Canal Flats, it serves as a natural waypoint.

address.value: 4966 Fairmont Frontage, Fairmont Hot Springs, V0B 1L0
